title: Apple signaled it could abandon a crucial tool for game developers - and it could come back to haunt it (AAPL)
text: Apple signaled it could abandon a crucial tool for game developers — and it could come back to haunt it (AAPL) By David Choi Jun 6, 2018, 9:02 pm 17 pts Apple announced during its annual Worldwide Developers Conference that OpenGL, a longtime tool for game developers, will "no longer be used in active development" on MacOS and instead, encouraged them to adopt Metal, its newer, proprietary tool.
